a.lede: The state attorney general says she would ‘not hesitate to enforce’ the five-year ban signed by Governor Kathy Hochul The New York governor, Kathy Hochul , signed legislation on Wednesday that places a five-year ban on the manufacture and sale of toys powered by AI chatbots, including talking stuffed animals, dolls and robots that use the internet to hold conversations
a.title: New York bans AI toys, including those using internet to talk to children

b.lede: New York Governor Kathy Hochul has signed a bill that effectively bans the sale of toys with built-in AI chatbots within the state over concerns about what they might say to kids.
b.title: New York Governor Kathy Hochul signs ban on AI chatbot toys backed by $15,000 daily fines
